record.product: Single-user green-power direct-connection projects (grid-connected and off-grid types)
record.status_detail: Key parameters: for grid-connected projects, annual self-generated and self-consumed electricity >=60% of total available generation and >=30% of total consumption (>=35% before 2030); annual feed-in in principle <=20% (set at provincial level); no reverse feed-in during consumption-constrained periods
